messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail.

message.content: {"animals": ["donkey", "zebra"], "attached_objects": [], "description": "A slender four-legged equid shown in right-facing profile with a donkey-like body. The coat is shaggy brown-gray on the head, neck and back, fading to pale off-white on the muzzle, underside of the neck, belly and lower legs. The head is long with a white muzzle, dark nostril, dark eye with a pale ring, and two very long upright ears. A short stiff upright mane runs along the top of the neck. The torso is narrow with a slightly swayed back and a dark stripe along the spine. The legs are long and slender ending in small dark single hooves. A thin tail with a dark tuft hangs from the rear. Dark narrow stripes mark the neck, shoulder, torso, hindquarters and legs.", "extra_limb_pieces": 0, "heads": 1, "parts": [{"looks_like": "long narrow donkey-like head with brown fur, white around the muzzle and lower jaw, dark eye with pale eye-ring and dark nostril", "part": "head", "where": "at the front top of the body, facing to the right"}, {"looks_like": "two very long upright pointed ears with dark tips and pale inner fur", "part": "ears", "where": "on top of the head"}, {"looks_like": "short stiff upright dark mane with pale banding", "part": "mane", "where": "along the top of the neck from behind the ears to the shoulders"}, {"looks_like": "four long slender legs with brown-gray fur fading to pale below, with dark horizontal striping", "part": "legs", "where": "underneath the body, two in front and two in rear"}, {"looks_like": "small dark single hooves", "part": "feet", "where": "at the ends of the four legs"}, {"looks_like": "thin short-haired tail with a dark tuft of longer hair at the end", "part": "tail", "where": "at the rear of the body hanging down"}, {"looks_like": "narrow dark brown-black stripes on the neck, shoulder, torso, hindquarters and legs, plus a dark dorsal stripe along the back", "part": "markings", "where": "across the body, most prominent on the rear half, shoulder and legs"}], "separate_bodies": 1, "walking_legs": 4, "wings": 0}
